fix(runtime): retry node runtime downloads

## Problem

The latest Release run [45174751409](https://github.com/aipoch/open-science/actions/runs/45174751409) failed in `build / Build macos-x64`. `scripts/stage-node-runtime.mjs` aborted when the macOS runner hit `UND_ERR_CONNECT_TIMEOUT` while downloading the pinned Node runtime from `nodejs.org`.

## Proposed change

Add a bounded three-attempt download retry with 5-second and 15-second backoff delays. Retry transport failures and HTTP 429/5xx responses while preserving immediate failure for non-transient responses. Add focused tests for retry success and non-transient failure.

## Scope

- Update Node runtime archive downloading in `scripts/stage-node-runtime.mjs`.
- Add focused coverage in `scripts/stage-node-runtime.test.ts`.
- No UI, persistence, data migration, enum, or user-visible copy changes.

## Validation

- `npx vitest run scripts/stage-node-runtime.test.ts`
- `npx prettier --check scripts/stage-node-runtime.mjs scripts/stage-node-runtime.test.ts`
- `npx eslint scripts/stage-node-runtime.mjs scripts/stage-node-runtime.test.ts`
- `npm run lint`
- `git diff --check`

## Review focus

- Confirm retry classification is limited to transient network and server responses.
- Confirm the per-attempt timeout and bounded backoff keep release failures finite.
- Confirm the existing checksum validation and temporary-file cleanup remain unchanged.

fix(backend): take the overview's has_more from GitHub's next page

Closes #155

**Bug:** the *Pull requests* tile and sidebar count showed **0+** with no open pull requests (owner's screenshot, minutes after merging a PR).

**Cause:** `_list_total` computed `has_more = issueCount > len(nodes)`. GitHub's search count can still include an item the search no longer returns (index lag after a merge or close), so a count of 1 with no items meant "more than shown". Nodes GitHub returns as `null` also counted as loaded although Hoot drops them.

**Fix:** the overview query asks for `pageInfo { hasNextPage }` on each search, and `has_more` is GitHub's own answer to "is there another page", as the list pages (`lists.py`) already do. `total` stays GitHub's count. The fake GitHub already sends `pageInfo`.

**Tests:** `pytest` 210 passed. New: a count of 1 with no items and no next page gives `has_more: false` (fails on the old code). The test fixture now sends `pageInfo` like GitHub. `docs/api.md` updated.

fix(insurance): editing a policy whose vehicles were all deleted saves again

Fixes #1335

## What
`InsurancePolicyForm.svelte` `validate()` required at least one covered vehicle in **edit mode** as well. Edit mode hides the Covered Vehicles field. Deleting a vehicle removes it from its policies, so a policy whose vehicles were all deleted couldn't be saved: Update Policy did nothing, showed no error and had no field to focus.

The vehicles check now runs in create mode only. That matches the rest of the form: edit mode sends only company, notes and the active flag (`updatePolicySchema`), and the server checks ownership by user, not by vehicle.

## Evidence (Playwright chromium; a policy whose only vehicle was deleted, so `vehicleIds: []`)
**Before | after (1280, light):** before, pressing Update Policy sends no request and stays on the form with no message. After, it saves and returns to Insurance with "Policy updated successfully".

![1280](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OnlyOneByte/VROOM/pr-assets/pr-1342/policy-1280.png)

**After, 375, light | dark**, the same result:

![375](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OnlyOneByte/VROOM/pr-assets/pr-1342/policy-375.png)

Recorded requests and outcome:
- Before: 0 PUT requests, still on `/insurance/<id>/edit`, no toast.
- After: 1 PUT, then `/insurance` and the success toast, at both 375 and 1280 in light and dark.

## Tests
`insurance-policy-form.test.ts`: "saves a policy whose vehicles were all deleted", in edit mode with `vehicleIds: []`. `updatePolicy` is called and no vehicles error shows. It fails on main. The insurance component tests pass locally (15 files, 201 tests). eslint is clean.

Not checked: other themes. The change is a validation branch only and doesn't change any styling.

fix(settings): one shared currency list for the picker and the settings API

Fixes #1319

## What
The Settings currency picker and the settings API now use one list, so the picker never offers a code the server rejects.

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Picker | browser `Intl.supportedValuesOf('currency')`, 0/2 decimals (153 in Chromium) | `CURRENCIES` in `frontend/src/lib/constants/currencies.ts` (147) |
| `PUT /settings` `currencyUnit` | Bun's `Intl` list (306 codes, including DEM, FRF and other historic ones) | `backend/src/shared-currencies.json` (147) |
| Kept in step by | nothing | `currencies-parity.test.ts`, the same pattern as `limits-parity.test.ts` (the frontend image builds from `frontend/` alone, so it can't import the backend file) |

**What the list is:** Node 22's `Intl` currencies with 0 or 2 decimals, minus:
- **3-decimal currencies:** BHD, JOD, KWD, LYD, OMR, TND, and IQD (3 in ISO 4217 and in Bun, 0 in Chromium)
- **Withdrawn currencies:** HRK and BGN (now the euro), SLL (now SLE), ZWL (now ZWG), CUC, and ANG (now XCG)
- **Non-currencies:** XDR, XSU

XCG and ZWG are in, so the server accepts them whatever its runtime's `Intl` knows. VED (the digital bolívar) is current but missing from the browser and Node lists, so it stays out; VES is in.

**A saved code outside the list** (for example HRK, set before this change) still shows on the trigger and as the first option. Saves send `currencyUnit` only when the user picks a new one, so a legacy code is never re-sent and rejected. `pickerCurrencyCodes` is removed from `formatters.ts`; `currencyLabel` stays.

## Evidence
A JPY user with the picker open. Before, the list around JPY includes HRK and IQD; after, it doesn't.

## Tests
- `currency-unit.test.ts` (backend):
  - the list is sorted, unique and 3 letters per code, with no 3-decimal currency under Bun's `Intl`
  - `PUT /settings` accepts JPY, EUR, ZWG and XCG
  - it rejects HRK, BGN, DEM, XDR, BHD and ABC, and the saved currency stays unchanged
- `currencies-parity.test.ts`: the frontend list equals the backend file.
- `unit-preferences-card.test.ts`: the picker offers exactly `CURRENCIES` and none of the dropped codes, and a saved BHD or HRK still shows.
- Backend 3533/3533, frontend 5505/5505, `test:tz` 1324/1324. Biome, eslint, prettier and both type-checks clean.

test(overlay): artefact-environment render cases get a 180 s timeout

`backend-suite` on `master` ff7efc3e8 ([run 45156849521](https://github.com/endora-commerce/endora-commerce/actions/runs/45156849521)) failed in shard 1 with 1 failed test and 3562 passed: `test/overlay/us3-artifact-env-independence.test.ts` › *renders every artefact byte-identically with and without DEPLOYMENT=example* hit `Test timed out in 30000ms`. It found no difference; it ran out of time.

- That shard took 4101 s, against 2719 s in the previous run, where the whole file passed in 25.7 s, close to the 30 s default.
- On a 16-thread developer machine the two cases that call `renderAll()` take **48.7 s** (two renders) and **25.0 s** (one render).

**Change, test only:** those two cases get `RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS = 180_000`, with a comment explaining why. The other eight cases, and the assertions, are unchanged.

**Verified locally:** 10/10 passed. ESLint is clean, and an empty changeset is included.
